name: Jack-o-Lantern
note: Jack-o'-lantern: Shade the rib grooves and the right side of the pumpkin with deep red-brown, keeping a broad sheen on the left ribs. Make the purple sunburst slightly lighter and less saturated.

name: Witch Hat
note: Witch Hat: Paint the hat in deep plum-purple felt with violet shadows instead of black, with a soft lighter sheen down the left of the cone. Make the green rings slightly softer and lighter, with no bright yellow-green core behind the brim.

name: Bat
note: Bat: Change the sunburst to cool violet-purple rays. Paint the wing membranes dusky violet-brown and draw the body fur as a few soft rounded clumps instead of strands.

name: Candlestick
note: Candlestick: Replace the grey speckled stone counter with a smooth warm honey-wood ledge. Let the flame cast a small warm glow on the candle top and the inside of the dish. Put the right side of the brass stem in clear shadow.

name: Cauldron
note: Cauldron: Paint the pot dark blue-violet iron with a lit rim and a broad soft highlight on the upper left of the belly instead of solid black, with no scratches. Remove the daisies. Make the pink rings an even, slightly dustier rose with no bright spot behind the pot.

name: Candy Corn
note: Candy Corn: Light from the upper right so the left side of the candy is clearly darker, matching its cast shadow. Make the tip a warm waxy cream. Darken the wall stripes slightly so the tip is the brightest spot.

name: Haunted House
note: Haunted House: Remove the moon and the daisies. Paint the stone walls a warm lilac and the roofs deep plum, with the side wall and the right of the tower slightly darker. Make the sky and grass slightly softer and less saturated.

name: Spooky Tree
note: Spooky Tree: Remove the falling orange leaf. Light from the upper left so the right side of the trunk is slightly darker, and add a soft tree shadow on the grass to the right.

name: Ghost Sheep
note: Ghost Sheep: Remove the jack-o'-lantern and the motion lines; the sheep stands alone on the lawn. Make the sky a calm daytime blue with only a hint of lavender. Shade the sheet folds in soft blue-grey, slightly lighter.

name: Jack-o'-Lantern
note: Cargo Barrel (pumpkin): Make the table smooth warm-brown planks with a few soft grain lines and no peeling paint, scratches or nail heads. Make the blue sky even, with no glow behind the pumpkin. Keep the pumpkin as is.

name: Witch Hat
note: Witch Hat: Make the hat a deep plum-purple felt instead of black, with soft violet lit faces on the crown and brim and rich indigo shadows. Make the background rays a slightly deeper teal. Keep the hat shape and band.

name: Cauldron
note: Cooler Box (cauldron): Make the pot a dark blue-grey iron with a lit rim and a lighter left side instead of solid black, and let the fire cast warm orange light onto its underside and legs. Make the wall and floor a slightly brighter lavender with fewer cracks. Keep the scene otherwise.

name: Crystal Ball
note: Vending (crystal ball): Remove the bright glow behind the ball and keep the green rings tone-on-tone. Replace the hard white window highlight with a small soft highlight at the upper left and slightly darken the right side of the glass. Keep the stand as is.

name: Haunted Door
note: Haunted Door: Light from the upper left so the arch stones cast soft shadows down onto the wooden planks and the right side of each stone is darker. Make the stone wall a slightly richer lavender-blue instead of grey. Keep the door as is.

name: Spooky Tree
note: Spooky Tree: Replace the castle tower with soft distant bushes. Light from the upper left so the right side of the trunk and roots is slightly darker, and add a soft tree shadow on the grass to the right. Keep the tree as is.

name: Potion
note: Treasure (potion): Make the tabletop smooth, clean warm-brown planks with no moss, grime or nail heads. Make the pink background even, with no pale glow behind the bottle. Keep the bottle and its green glow.

name: Boo Surprise
note: Selfie: Remove the pumpkin and the ivy leaves. Paint the door and porch boards in smooth, clean colors with no peeling paint or grain scratches. Light the whole porch evenly so the corners are not darkened.

name: Robot
note: Replace the riveted steel floor plates with a plain warm wooden ledge, and keep the striped yellow wall. Make the robot's white slightly cooler, with light blue-grey shadows on its right sides.

name: Space Helmet
note: Make the helmet shell a slightly cooler, clean white with light blue-grey shadows. Make the visor a deep smoky blue glass with one warm reflection.

name: Alien Pet
note: Replace the riveted metal floor with a plain wooden desk top or a soft gradient floor. Make the pink backdrop slightly more muted, and make the right side of the alien slightly darker.

name: Moon Rover
note: Paint the rover body bright orange with white trim. Smooth the ground into soft grey-beige dust with two or three large soft craters and no scattered pebbles or rocks.

name: Control Panel
note: Paint the console body a saturated teal-blue metal and keep the red buttons. Replace the glossy steel shelf with a plain soft floor and a gentle reflection, on the orange-yellow gradient.

name: Robot
note: Shade the robot's right side slightly cooler blue-grey; make the stripes a slightly deeper golden orange; matte wooden ledge without the glossy reflection.

name: Space Helmet
note: Slightly cooler white helmet shell with light blue-grey shading on the right side; visor slightly darker amber-gold than the background.

name: Alien Pet
note: One plain smooth cool-grey floor without plate seams or rivets; even warm pink backdrop with no spotlight or dark corners.

name: Moon Rover
note: Replace the cloudy sky with a smooth deep-blue space gradient; cool blue-grey ground with two or three large shallow craters; smooth orange deck without screws.

name: Control Panel
note: Soft contact shadow on a matte floor in place of the mirror reflection; satin teal finish instead of hard white edge highlights; no corner screws.

name: Rocket
note: Rocket: Replace the concrete floor with a smooth painted floor in soft cool blue, with no grit or seams. Give the white body a soft glossy sheen, lit from the upper left so its right side is slightly cooler and darker. Keep the orange-yellow stripes.

name: Flying Saucer
note: UFO: Paint the saucer as smooth soft grey metal with one broad highlight on top and no brushed streaks, and use fewer rivets. Light it from the upper left so the lower and far edge of the rim is slightly darker and cooler.

name: Comet
note: Meteor: Give the rock a grey stone colour with a darker lower side and craters lit from one direction. Draw the tail as a smooth pale blue trail with clean edges and no wispy streaks. Replace the wavy ribbons with soft orange sunburst rays.

name: Control Panel
note: Control Console: Paint the console body a saturated teal-blue metal with silver trim, and keep the red buttons. Replace the white slab with a plain soft floor in a slightly darker blue, with a gentle reflection.

name: Teleport Pod
note: Stasis Tube: Fill the glass with softly glowing orange liquid. Paint the cap and base ring a saturated blue with silver trim. Remove the cyan glow on the floor and add a soft dark contact shadow under the base.

name: Moon Rover
note: Moon Rover: Paint the rover body bright orange with white trim, and the tyres dark grey instead of black. Smooth the ground into soft grey-beige dust with two or three large soft craters and no scattered pebbles or small pits.

name: Moon Base
note: Moon Base: Paint the dome white with a bold teal stripe and the connecting tube bright yellow. Smooth the ground into soft blue-grey dust, slightly darker than the dome, with one or two large soft craters and no scattered pebbles or pits.

name: Zero Gravity
note: Astronaut: Make the cabin walls and seat a light neutral grey-white, and keep purple only in the small ceiling and wall lights. Shade the skin with warm brown and the yellow trousers with darker yellow-orange, not violet.

name: Flying Saucer
note: Plane (UFO): Remove the rivets on the hull. Make the rim lights soft warm yellow dots that cast a small warm glow onto the hull next to them. Light from the upper left so the right side of the saucer is slightly darker. Keep the sky and clouds.

name: Satellite
note: Satellite: Make the gold box a satin painted gold with one soft broad highlight instead of mirror chrome and white streaks, and make its right side face clearly darker. Make the solar panels soft matte blue with fewer, softer cell lines. Keep the green rays.

name: Glow Flask
note: Vending (flask): Make the glass clear pale grey-blue with white edge highlights instead of pink-tinted. Make the left side of the glass and the liquid slightly darker, with the liquid a slightly deeper yellow-green. Keep the pink background.

name: Moon Rover
note: Computer (rover): Replace the gritty grey gravel with a smooth, softly shaded dusty warm-grey ground with no pebbles or rocks. Give the white body orange trim panels. Light from the front left so the right side of the body and the inner wheel faces are clearly darker.

name: Star Map
note: Map (star chart): Make the disc face a slightly lighter medium navy blue with a soft glow across its upper half. Paint the constellation lines and stars as softer, slightly glowing marks, and drop the thin grid circles. Light the rim brightly on the upper-left edge.

name: Rocket
note: Rocket: Make the ground a smooth, softly shaded grey launch pad with no paving joints or grain. Remove the rivet row under the nose cone. Light from the upper left to match the cast shadow, so the right half of the body and the right faces of the fins are clearly darker.

name: Control Panel
note: Control Panel: Remove the porthole, the ceiling light strip and the wall rivets and seams, leaving a plain smooth purple wall slightly darker than the panel. Light from the upper left so the panel casts a soft shadow onto the wall at the lower right. Keep the panel as is.

name: Space Farm
note: Hitchhike (cow and rooster): Remove the flying saucer and its light beam and leave plain sky. Make the spacesuits soft matte white fabric with a few gentle folds and only a small sheen, keeping the orange trim. Make the grass a slightly smoother, even green with fewer tufts.

name: Saddle
note: Saddle: Replace the dashed stitching with a few soft solid seam lines at the main panel edges. Cast a soft dark shadow from the saddle onto the wooden rail just below and to its right. Keep the rest of the card as is.

name: Pig Roper
note: Pig Roper: Make the dirt ground a paler dusty grey-beige with fewer pebbles, and the fence weathered grey-brown wood. Light the pig from the upper left so its right side and belly underside are slightly darker. Keep the pig, hat, lasso and sky as they are.

name: Saddle
note: Saddle: Replace the dashed stitching with a few soft solid seam lines, and make the stirrups and buckles soft satin grey. Remove the lower fence rail and keep the blue stripes. Keep the saddle's shape and color.

name: Pig Roper
note: Pig Roper: Remove the scattered pebbles and dust specks and make the dirt a smooth, even warm tone. Make the fence and ground slightly darker so the pig is the lightest shape. Light from the upper left so the pig's right flank is slightly darker, and add a soft shadow under each hoof.

name: Cowboy Hat
note: Make the blue rays even, with only a slightly lighter centre and slightly darker corners, instead of the near-white burst behind the hat. Shade the crown dent and the brim underside slightly toward a plum-brown.

name: Sheriff Star
note: Light the star from the upper left so the lower-right arms are slightly darker. Keep bright highlights on only one or two ring balls. Darken the purple rings slightly toward the card corners.

name: Cowboy Boots
note: Change the background stripes to cool teal or sky blue. Replace the dotted turquoise stitching with a few soft solid lines. Light from the upper left so each shaft has a broad lighter face and a darker side.

name: Horseshoe
note: Paint the horseshoe as cool steel grey with bluish shadows and one crisp bright highlight along the top edge. Make the pink wall an even tone with no glow spot behind the horseshoe. Soften the dark cast shadow on the table slightly.

name: Cactus
note: Calm the bright white glow behind the cactus so the cyan rays brighten only slightly toward the centre. Slightly soften and lighten the cast shadow on the sand.

name: Saddle
note: Make the saddle smooth leather with no dashed stitching and no pore grain. Light from the upper left, with a darker right flap and the saddle's shadow cast onto the beam. Turn the pad a slightly more muted red.

name: Lasso
note: Give the rope a matte fibre finish instead of a satin sheen on every twist. Slightly deepen the brown shadows between the coils so the lasso separates from the sand.

name: Saloon
note: Paint the saloon in a saturated warm brown wood with broad smooth planks and no fine grain. Remove the fences, shrubs, rocks and scattered pebbles, and leave smooth sand. Keep the distant mesas and sky.

name: Wagon
note: Remove the sun disc and the daisies. Make the grass a slightly smoother, even green with fewer blades. Keep the wagon as is.

name: Campfire
note: Let the fire cast warm orange light onto the underside of the pot, the inner faces of the logs and the stones. Make the pot dark grey with a lit rim instead of solid black. Keep the scene otherwise.

name: Cowboy Hat
note: Cowboy Hat: Light from the upper left so the right side of the crown and the right brim curl are clearly darker. Make the felt a slightly deeper, less orange brown with a deep umber shadow under the brim. Keep the background rays.

name: Cowboy Boot
note: Cowboy Boot: Replace the dashed stitching with a few soft solid seam lines. Light the green wall evenly so its corners and the shelf edge are not darkened. Keep the boot otherwise.

name: Cactus
note: Cactus: Remove the pebbles around the base and make the sand smooth and slightly paler than the orange wall. Light from the upper left so the right arm and the right side of the trunk are slightly darker.

name: Horseshoe
note: Horseshoe: Change the pink diamond wall to a soft sky-blue diamond pattern. Remove the pebbles and make the sand smooth. Give the horseshoe a bright silver highlight along its upper-left edge.

name: Covered Wagon
note: Wagon: Remove the pebbles, the rock and the grass tufts at the bottom corners, and make the dirt road one smooth, even warm tone. Make the canvas cover a slightly whiter off-white with cool grey folds. Keep the wagon as is.

name: Windmill
note: Windmill: Paint the wheel rim and hub a dark iron red so the wheel has strong accents, and keep the blades white. Give the stone tower a clearer, darker shadow side. Make the wheat field a smooth, slightly deeper gold with only a few blade tips.

name: Mesa
note: Mesa: Remove the shrubs, grass tufts and pebbles and make the sand smooth and even. Light from the left with strong sun so the right cliff faces turn deep red-brown and the top ledges catch bright light.

name: Cactus
note: Cactus: Make the cactus a slightly deeper, natural green with a clearer dark side down the left of the trunk and arms. Turn its cast shadow on the pink floor a deeper rose-violet instead of grey. Keep the flower and backdrop.

name: Harmonica
note: Harmonica: Make the background rings slightly lighter and crisper, as evenly spaced light and dark violet bands out to the edges. Give the silver cover a faint cool blue tint in its shadows. Keep the harmonica otherwise.

name: Cowboy Boots
note: Boots: Replace the dashed stitching with a few soft solid seam lines. Make the ground a smooth, even tan with no cracks or pebbles. Light the purple stripes evenly so the corners are not darkened. Keep the boots otherwise.

name: Saloon Doors
note: Saloon Doors: Paint the wall and floor planks as smooth boards with only faint, sparse grain, in a slightly greyer weathered brown with cool blue-grey shadows. Make the view through the doorway a brighter blue sky with greener bushes. Keep the red frame and the doors.

name: Lasso
note: Lasso: Make the background a slightly deeper blue with clearer light and dark wave bands. Draw the rope twists as soft broad bands without fibre fuzz. Keep the red bandana and the loops.

name: Wagon
note: Wagon: Make the background diamonds alternate slightly more clearly between light and mid blue. Make the dirt a smooth, slightly greyer tan with no pebbles. Keep the wagon as is.

name: Horseshoe
note: Horseshoe: Make the table smooth planks with soft, faint grain and no scratches, chips or knots, in a slightly deeper, greyer brown. Make the horseshoe smooth satin metal without brush streaks, with a faint cool blue tint on its shadow side. Keep the gold nails.

name: Campfire
note: Campfire: Remove the tent and the scattered pebbles and grass tufts, and make the ground a smoother, slightly greyer brown. Make the stones cool blue-grey with violet shadows on the side away from the fire. Keep the fire, logs, kettle and trees.

name: Hat Tip
note: Pig & Farmer: Make the sky a clearer blue and add a few green bushes along the building's base. Remove the pebbles and make the dirt smooth and slightly greyer. Give the wooden porch and wall slightly cooler, plum-brown shadows. Keep the characters as is.

name: Satellite
note: Satellite: Make the gold foil body smooth with only two or three broad soft folds, and make the dish soft satin silver instead of mirror chrome. Make the orange rings slightly softer and less saturated, and give the satellite a slightly cool shadow side on its right.

name: Space Gloves
note: Space Gloves: Paint the gloves a neutral light grey-white with cool grey shadows instead of purple-tinted ones. Even out the purple background with only a gentle darkening at the corners. Keep the orange cuffs and the teal patches.

name: Toy Spaceship
note: Spaceship: Paint the hull glossy white with a red stripe along the side, and make the engine nozzles dark blue-grey metal. Replace the lime studio gradient with an even, mid-tone green background, and put a short soft shadow right under the ship. Light from the upper left so the underside and right flank are clearly darker.

name: Moon Rover
note: Rover: Make the body matte white with a few soft panel seams and an orange stripe, and keep only a thin highlight along its top edge. Make the sand a smooth, slightly deeper warm ochre. Give the rover's right side and the wheels a clear cool blue-grey shadow side.

name: Star Map
note: Star Map: Paint the chart a slightly lighter mid blue with soft lighter and darker fold panels, and remove the speckled noise. Make the compass warm brass with a small soft shine. Keep the stars and the wooden table.

name: Control Panel
note: Control Panel: Make the wall one plain, slightly deeper warm yellow surface with no rivets, vents or seams, and make the floor smooth and plain. Light from the upper left so the right side of the console and the undersides of the buttons are slightly darker. Keep the screen, dial and levers.

name: Kettle
note: Kettle: Replace the purple gradient with a violet radial sunburst of light and mid violet rays. Replace the sharp white glints with one broad soft sheen on the upper left, and make the right side of the body a slightly deeper wine red. Make the handle dark grey instead of black.

name: Whisk
note: Whisk: Replace the blurry green field and light shafts with an even green radial sunburst of light and mid green rays. Give the wires a soft silver sheen, brighter on the left wires and slightly darker on the right. Keep the orange handle.

name: Sink Tap
note: Faucet: Make the wall tiles a smooth light teal with soft, faint grout lines, and remove the yellow sunbeam streaks. Make the chrome a soft satin with one bright highlight down the left of the neck and a slightly darker right side. Keep the drops, the blue knob and the sink.

name: Toaster
note: Toaster: Replace the pink studio gradient with a pink radial sunburst of light and mid pink rays, and keep a short soft shadow under the feet. Make the body smooth satin chrome without brushed streaks, with a faint cool blue tint on its shadow side. Keep the toast and the red knob.

name: Oven Mitts
note: Oven Mitts: Replace the dashed stitching around the house patch with a soft solid seam. Make the orange fabric smooth with no fuzz, keeping the quilted diamonds as soft shallow puffs. Keep the mitts, colors and backdrop otherwise.

name: Rolling Pin
note: Rolling Pin: Replace the white marble counter with a smooth painted wooden counter in a mid tone, slightly darker than the dough. Make the wood grain on the pin fine and faint, and keep only a light dusting of flour. Keep the red handles and the purple glow.

name: Cookie Jar
note: Cookie Jar: Replace the marble with a smooth painted wooden counter in a warm mid tan, slightly darker than the jar. Give the jar a soft glaze with one small highlight on the upper left and a slightly deeper warm shadow on its right side, with a short contact shadow under it. Keep the cow face, cookies and red lid.

name: Treasure Chest
note: Treasure: Change the lid lining to a smooth, slightly darker maroon without velvet texture. Make the wood planks smooth with faint grain, with a clearly darker right side panel and cool dark-brown shadows. Keep the coins and the sand.

name: Pirate Hat

name: Pirate Ship
note: Galleon: Light from the left so each sail shades from a bright left edge to soft grey on the right, and the right side of the hull goes darker. Add a dark reflection of the hull on the water, and slightly deepen the sea toward the bottom edge. Keep the ship as is.

name: Treasure Map
note: Treasure Map: Tone the paper slightly to a warm cream. Light from the upper left so each fold has a lit face and a slightly shaded face. Add a soft, darker shadow under the sheet and the curled edges. Keep the drawing on the map.

name: Spyglass
note: Spyglass: Make the leather grip smooth dark brown with a soft sheen and no visible grain. Give the brass broader, softer reflections. Keep the lens and the green burst.

name: Ship Wheel
note: Ship's Wheel: Make the deck a few wide, smooth planks with faint grain in a slightly paler, greyer brown. Paint the wheel a slightly deeper, richer brown with cool dark-brown shadows. Keep the brass ring and the sea.

name: Anchor
note: Anchor: Change the yellow wall to a clear blue sky with soft sea haze, and remove the bright glow behind the anchor. Make the iron a slightly lighter blue-grey with a darker shadow side on the right. Make the deck a few wide, smooth planks with faint grain in a slightly paler, greyer brown.

name: Toaster
note: Toaster: Make the chrome a soft satin with one broad highlight down the left of the front and a slightly darker right side, in place of the mirror reflections. name: Chopping Board
note: Cutting Board: Make the tablecloth a soft pale blue with faint, low-contrast light blue checks, with no pure white squares and no weave texture. name: Soup Pot
note: Cooking Pot: Remove the water droplets from the lid and pot, and give the teal enamel one soft broad highlight. Keep the flame glow small and right under the pot, and make the stovetop a slightly lighter neutral dark grey with no orange spill. Keep the tiles, the steam and the handles.

name: Sheriff Pals
note: Sheriff Pals: Saloon: Make the saloon wall a faded grey-blue instead of red, keeping the red only on the plaid shirt. Paint the plaid as soft, broad colour blocks without crisp lines. Make the boardwalk planks smooth with faint grain; keep the characters, the mug and the hats.

name: Ranch Hands
note: Ranch Hands: Farmyard: Draw the hay bale as a few broad, soft clumps in a slightly paler, duller straw colour. Make the bucket soft grey metal with one broad highlight. Lighten the leaf canopy in the top-left corner to the same mid green as the bushes; keep the cow, the rooster and the barn.

name: Bridge Crew
note: Bridge Crew: Cockpit: Make the spacesuits a soft matte white-grey fabric with a gentle sheen only on the top edges, in place of the chrome. Lighten the dark cabin corners to a mid lavender. Remove the yellow-and-cyan button panel and the blue light strips; keep the red button, the window and the characters.

name: Sky Watchers
note: Sky Watchers: Meadow: Remove the fern leaves in the bottom corners and the scattered grass tufts, so the lawn is smooth. Make the grass a slightly deeper, less yellow green and the sky a slightly softer blue with a paler horizon. Keep the characters, the UFO and the trees.

name: Trick Treat
note: Shopping: Trick-or-Treat Porch: Make the door and porch boards a muted grey-brown and let slightly more deep blue night show, keeping the lantern glow small. Make the ghost sheet and the cow's white body a clean cool white with soft lilac-blue shadows. Remove the yellow knock lines by the door; keep the characters, the pumpkin bucket and the lantern.

name: Vampire Night
note: Vampire Night: Living Room: Make the walls a cool dusk blue and the rug a smooth soft grey-beige with no fuzzy fibres, keeping the red only on the curtain. Remove the table lamp, the houseplant and the mustard throw, leaving a plain dim wall and the window. Make the bandages a clean white with soft cool grey shadows and softer edges between the wraps.

name: Saddle
note: Saddle: Draw the hay bale as a few broad, soft clumps in a slightly paler, duller straw colour. Make the leather smooth with a soft sheen, with one subtle seam in place of the stitch lines on every edge and no rivets. Keep the stirrup, the horn, the rope ties and the cyan backdrop.

name: Barrel
note: Barrel: Make the dirt floor a smooth, plain soft brown with no pebbles or specks, and make the cast shadow softer and shorter. Make the wood grain on the staves faint and fine in place of the big swirls. Keep the emblem, the iron hoops and the blue stripes.

name: Covered Wagon
note: Covered Wagon: Make the dirt ground smooth and plain with no pebbles or specks. Paint the canvas as smooth cream with a few broad soft folds, with no stitched seams. Make the wheel rims a slightly muted brick red, shaped by light and shadow rather than dark outlines; keep the green stripes and the tongue.

name: Windmill
note: Windmill: Remove the stone base, so the tower legs stand straight on smooth, plain dry ground. Paint the grass as a few soft, broad straw-coloured clumps with no single blades or pebbles. Make the wheel rim a smooth metal ring with no rivets; keep the blades, the red tail vane, the sky and the clouds.

name: Campfire Pot
note: Campfire Pot: Remove the cabin, the moon and the stars, leaving a soft, dark blue forest behind. Make the kettle smooth, softly shiny enamel and the stones smooth grey with no speckles. Keep the fire, the logs, the kettle on its rock and the stone ring.

name: Lab Flask
note: Lab Flask: Make the counter a plain smooth mid-grey surface with no brushed streaks and no green reflection. Make the liquid a slightly deeper, natural green with darker olive depths. Make the pink wall one even tone with no glow behind the flask; keep the cork and bubbles.

name: Airlock Door
note: Airlock Door: Make the surrounding wall a mid blue-grey metal instead of white, keeping the cyan light strips. Make the door ring a soft satin steel with one broad highlight and a darker shadow groove around it. Keep the orange wheel and the hinges.

name: Circuit Chip

name: Satellite
note: Honor Medal: Satellite: Make the gold body a smooth gold box with two or three broad soft folds instead of crinkled foil. Change the green burst to even deep blue rays with no bright glow behind the satellite. Keep the blue solar panels and the dish.

name: Radar Dish
note: Fan: Radar Dish: Make the rooftop a smooth warm sandstone colour with no speckle and a soft-edged shadow. Make the sky a slightly deeper blue. Paint the mount column a soft orange-red with the dish staying white; keep the red tip.

name: Control Panel
note: Control Panel: Make the counter a plain matte mid-grey with no brushed streaks or reflections. Paint the console body a soft warm cream-yellow with a slightly darker right side. Keep the radar screen, gauges, levers, red button and blue wall.

name: Moon Rover
note: Vehicle: Remove the scattered rocks and pebbles so the ground is smooth with two or three large soft craters. name: Spurs
note: Spurs: Make the metal a satin grey with one soft highlight along each bar, in place of the mirror chrome. Make the straps plain smooth leather in a slightly deeper brown, with no stitching. Keep the rowels, the buckles and the blue rings.

name: Harmonica
note: Harmonica: Make the cover a satin grey metal with one broad soft highlight along the top and a slightly darker front face, in place of the mirror streaks. Make the red end caps plain, with no rivets. Keep the holes and the cyan wave background.

name: Cactus Pot
note: Cactus Pot: Add soft, tone-on-tone purple rings behind the pot, evenly bright out to the corners. Keep the cactus, the flower, the pot and the shadow.

name: Boots
note: Cowboy Boots: Remove the spurs. Paint the flame pattern as smooth red shapes with no dotted stitching. Make the right side of each boot clearly darker and add soft contact shadows under the soles. Keep the pull tabs, the floor and the striped wall.

name: Guitar
note: Guitar: Make the floor a few wide, smooth boards in a slightly paler, even tone with faint seams and no knots. Light the card evenly with no darkened corners or spotlight. Give the guitar top one broad soft sheen and a soft contact shadow. Keep the red pickguard and the strings.

name: Bean Plate
note: Baked Beans: Give the beans a soft satin sheen with fewer tiny highlights. Make the bowl rim a cool silver grey with one broad highlight. Make the soft shadow from the bowl onto the table to the lower right slightly darker. Keep the blue stripe, the spoon and the planks.

name: Water Pump
note: Water Pump: Make the pump smooth green painted metal with one soft highlight down the left side, with no speckle, rust or bolts. Change the sky to pale blue and the ground to a soft beige-green with no scattered tufts or pebbles. Make the stone base a plain smooth grey. Keep the red handle and the spout.

name: Mailbox
note: Mailbox: Remove the house picture from the door, leaving plain blue paint with one soft broad highlight and no scuffs or rivets. Change the sunset to a pale blue daytime sky, with natural mid-green grass and a muted beige dirt road. Keep the red flag, the knob and the post.

name: Covered Wagon
note: Covered Wagon: Make the canvas plain smooth cloth with no stitch seams and no brass tacks, and the boards smooth with only faint grain. Remove the pebbles and grass tufts so the dirt road is a smooth gradient. Make the wagon's cast shadow slightly shorter and softer. Keep the red wheels and the sky.

name: Flying Saucer
note: Submarine (UFO card): Remove the light beam and the glow under the saucer, so the yellow burst is even. Draw the rim lights as small solid warm bulbs with no halos. Keep the purple saucer, the green dome and the yellow burst.

name: Food Pouch
note: Boxing Gloves (pouch card): Make the foil a smooth satin silver with two or three broad soft folds and one broad highlight, in place of the fine crinkles. Add a bright orange printed label with a simple fruit on the front. Tint the floor a slightly deeper cyan than the stripes, with no white and a short soft shadow. Keep the red cap and the striped wall.

name: Porthole
note: Lighthouse (porthole card): Remove the glowing light strips and the riveted wall plates, leaving a smooth pink wall with one or two faint seams. Make the steel rim a soft satin, with one broad highlight on the upper left and a slightly darker lower right, and draw the bolts as small, soft bumps. Keep the navy window with its stars.

name: Jetpack
note: Jetpack: Make the tanks a slightly brighter satin silver, with one broad highlight on the left of each and a slightly darker right side. Lighten the dark green corners of the burst slightly so they are only gently darker than the centre. Keep the orange nozzles, the straps and the green burst.

name: Joystick
note: Joystick: Replace the brushed-steel counter with a plain floor in the same mid green as the walls, with no metal streaks and no hard front edge. Make the base a slightly lighter charcoal-grey plastic with a soft highlight along its top rim. Keep the red ball, the yellow button and the green room.

name: Observatory Dome
note: Park Gate (observatory card): Remove the white flower specks and grass tufts so the lawn is smooth. Paint the stone wall a warm pale sandstone and the dome a soft teal-grey, keeping white only on the ledge trim. Keep the red door, the slit, the trees and the sky.

name: Space Capsule
note: Space Capsule: Remove the rivets and the screwed-on hatch panel, leaving one or two smooth seams. Make the heat shield a medium copper-brown with a lit top edge, not near-black. Lift the right side of the cone slightly to a soft mid grey-blue. Keep the yellow window, the sky and the clouds.

name: Oil Lantern
note: Lantern: Paint the iron frame a slightly lighter gunmetal grey with soft broad highlights in place of the black with white edges. Let the flame cast warm orange light on the inner cage bars and the top of the base. Keep the glass globe and the cyan rays.

name: Wagon Wheel
note: Wagon wheel: Make the spokes and rim smooth orange wood with soft shading and no grain lines. Keep only four or five rivets on the rim. Keep the iron tyre and the blue diamond backdrop.

name: Boots
note: Boots: Draw the star and swirl decorations as smooth, broad raised yellow shapes in place of the dashed stitching. Make the red leather smooth with a soft satin sheen and no creases. Keep the spurs and the purple backdrop.

name: Saddle
note: Saddle: Make the leather smooth brown with a soft satin sheen and simple raised edges in place of the stitch dashes. Make the stirrup plates soft grey metal with one broad highlight. Keep the wooden rail and the blue stripes.

name: Tumbleweed
note: Tumbleweed: Make the twigs smooth warm brown with soft matte shading, with no bark streaks, grain lines or split ends. Keep the purple backdrop, the sand and the shadow.

name: Belt Buckle
note: Belt: Make the leather smooth soft brown with a gentle satin sheen and no stitch lines along the edges. Make the buckle soft satin grey metal with one broad highlight in place of the bright chrome rim. Keep the house emblem and the wooden planks.

name: Windmill
note: Windmill: Make the tower beams smooth orange-brown with soft shading, with no bolt heads or wood-grain streaks. Make the fan blades plain smooth grey with no rivets on the rim. Replace the stone plinth and dirt patch with golden grass running up to the tower feet; keep the sky and clouds.

name: Campfire Pot
note: Campfire: Remove the log cabin and the kettle on its stone, and let soft pine shapes fill that space. Make the ring stones smooth grey with soft shading, with no speckles and no loose pebbles. Lighten the night sky slightly to a deep dusk blue; keep the fire and the logs.

name: Tea Cup
note: Vending: Shade the cup and saucer in clean neutral white with soft cool grey shadows and a slightly darker right side, in place of the lavender tint. Draw the tea as a smooth amber surface without the ring of foam bubbles. Keep the blue rims, the steam and the purple background.

name: Top Hat
note: Top Hat: Make the hat a deep charcoal plum-black with a broad soft highlight down the lit left side of the crown and along the top of the brim, keeping the darkest black only under the brim. Keep the red band, the shape and the blue burst.

name: Parasol
note: Parasol: Draw the pink frill as a plain soft ruffle with smooth fabric and no punched lace holes. Shade the underside of the canopy and the frill folds in a slightly darker, cooler tone. Keep the yellow dome, the wooden crook handle and the blue rings.

name: Pocket Watch
note: Honor Medal: Make the gold case a soft satin gold with one broad highlight on the upper left and a slightly darker right side, in place of the mirror shine. Print the numerals slightly smaller in soft dark brown and make the crown a smooth knob. Make the green diamond background slightly deeper and calmer; keep the chain and the dial.

name: Lace Gloves
note: Lace Gloves: Make the gloves smooth white satin with only a few large, soft lace flowers near the cuffs and no mesh weave. Shade them with soft cool grey on the undersides and the right edges. Make the pink background slightly calmer and less hot; keep the blue bows and the wave pattern.

name: Quill Pen
note: Quill Pen: Make the feather a clean cool white with pale grey-blue shading in place of the cream. Make the inkwell's cast shadow slightly shorter, softer and lighter. Keep the green inkwell, the striped yellow wall and the table.

name: Sealed Letter
note: Sealed Letter: Make the envelope paper a slightly cooler off-white with soft pale grey shading along the bottom edge and the right side, in place of the cream. Give it a soft cast shadow on the wood to the lower right. Keep the red wax seal and the wooden planks.

name: Gramophone
note: Gramophone: Make the horn smooth brass with one or two broad soft highlights and no brushed streaks. Make the table a satin wood with faint grain and soft, blurred reflections. Lighten the purple corners slightly to a medium violet; keep the record, the box and the crank.

name: Velvet Chair
note: Velvet Chair: Make the upholstery a smooth matte red fabric with broad soft shading and no fine speckle. Let the cushion tops and arm rolls catch a slightly brighter red from the upper left, with a slightly darker right side. Make the floor a satin wood with faint grain and soft, blurred reflections; keep the gold buttons, the legs and the striped wall.

name: Front Door
note: Front Door: Remove the pink bougainvillea in the top corners and the fallen petals, leaving plain wall. Paint the brick wall a soft cool grey-beige with faint, low-contrast joints and soften the leaf shadows. Keep the green door, the fanlight, the steps and the two flower bushes.

name: Flying Saucer
note: Sunshade: Make the saucer hull a soft satin silver with one broad highlight along the top of the rim, in place of the mirror streaks. Keep the green rings even, with no glow from the bulbs spilling onto them. Keep the red dome and the rim bulbs.

name: Star Map
note: Map: Make the chart's blue a slightly lighter, softer navy with faint teal and violet nebula patches, in place of the flat ultramarine. Draw the grid and constellation lines slightly softer and hand-painted, without glow. Keep the cream frame, the gold corners, the stars and the compass.

name: Rocket
note: Rocket: Remove the rivets on the nose cone and the bolts around the porthole, leaving a plain thick porthole rim. Make the silver body a soft satin with one broad highlight on the left, in place of the hard chrome stripe. Add a slight warm orange glow from the flame on the nozzle and lower fins; keep the red nose, the fins and the clouds.

name: Moon Rover
note: Moon Rover: Make the moon ground a cool neutral grey with a few large smooth rocks and no scattered pebbles. Make the sky a deep blue-navy in place of the purple. Shade the white rover with cool grey shadows; keep the orange box, the dish and the seats.

name: Space Helmet
note: Sneakers: Replace the house badge on the ear cup with a plain orange disc. Make the purple backdrop one even tone, with no lighter patch behind the helmet. Shade the white shell with cool grey, not purple; keep the gold visor and the orange trim.

name: Drone
note: Drone: Make the sunburst one even mid yellow-orange from centre to corners, with no white glow behind the drone. Give the drone body a soft blue shell with white trim and cool grey shadows. Make the rotors dark blue-grey with a soft light top edge; keep the camera and the arms.

name: Tablet
note: Travel Book: Lay the tablet on a warm orange wooden desk in place of the brushed metal. Show a colourful map picture on the screen with one soft diagonal sheen, in place of the flat cyan and ring. Make the bezel dark grey with a satin light edge on the top left; keep the home button.

name: Power Cell
note: Power Cell: Make the metal caps a neutral steel grey with cool blue-grey shadows, in place of the pink tint. Tint the floor the same mid pink as the wall, with no pale patch at the bottom. Let the cyan core glow slightly onto the inner faces of the caps; keep the yellow ring and the glass tube.

name: Antenna Mast
note: Lighthouse: Replace the grey concrete roof with warm terracotta roof tiles in a few broad, soft painted shapes, with a short, soft, pale shadow. Paint the mast with red-and-white bands. Keep the red beacon, the dish, the antenna rods and the sky.

name: Fedora
note: Grad Cap: Make the hat a smooth matte felt with broad soft shading and no fuzz or grain. Warm the felt slightly to a soft taupe-brown. Make the green rings slightly calmer and less neon; keep the red band and the shape.

name: Press Camera
note: Lamp Post: Keep the blue sunburst rays an even brightness all the way to the centre, with no glow behind the camera. Make the body a smooth satin dark charcoal with no leather grain, lit softly from the upper left with a cool blue-grey shadow side. Make the flash dish a soft satin silver with one broad highlight; keep the bellows, the lens and the red button.

name: Badge
note: Badge: Make the shield face smooth satin silver with no brushed streaks, bright at the upper left and slightly darker toward the lower right. Make the shadow under the shield slightly shorter and tighter. Keep the gold rim, the house emblem and the purple background.

name: Rotary Phone
note: Boxing Gloves: Set the phone on a light warm honey-wood table with a few broad soft grain bands, in place of the dark mahogany. Make the phone a satin deep red with broad soft highlights from the upper left, in place of glossy black. Keep the gold dial, the coiled cord and the orange striped wall.

name: Typewriter
note: Typewriter: Place the typewriter on a light honey-orange wooden desk with a few broad soft grain bands, in place of the dark polished wood. Make the body a clear emerald green satin lit softly from the upper left, with a medium-green shadow side. Give the keys small soft highlights instead of sharp chrome hits; keep the paper, the roller and the orange wall.

name: Case File
note: Travel Book: Lay the folder on a warm orange wooden table painted as a few wide, soft grain bands, in place of the dark walnut with fine grain. Light the folder from the upper left so the front is bright at the top left and falls off slightly toward the lower right, with a soft cast shadow to the lower right. Keep the red clip, the fingerprint and the tab.

name: Bloodhound
note: Rocking Chair: Make the blue striped wall one even tone with no bright glow behind the dog. Paint the grass as a smooth, slightly softer green with a few broad soft blade shapes, not individual blades. Make the dog's shadows a deeper saturated orange-brown, with smoother fur and broad shading; keep the red collar, the ears and the pose.

name: Office Door
note: Office Door: Paint the door a warm medium brown with lighter lit panels, in place of the near-black. Light it from the upper left so the left edges of the frame catch light and the right edges darken slightly. Tone the cyan wall slightly softer and darker; keep the magnifier window, the brass knob and the hinges.

name: Pumpkin
note: Pumpkin: Make the purple backdrop one even mid violet to the corners, with a quiet tone-on-tone ray pattern and no glow behind the pumpkin. Add a plain purple floor plane under it with a crisp dark plum contact shadow. Shade the right side and the rib grooves slightly darker in burnt orange; keep the glowing face and the stem.

name: Candelabra
note: Candelabra: Make the striped wall a brighter mid purple and the table a lighter warm wood with smooth satin faint grain, with no orange light pools on it. Paint the candelabra a soft satin silver with cool blue-grey shadows, lit softly from the upper left. Keep the small candle flames, the candles and the stripes.

name: Crystal Ball
note: Crystal Ball: Make the table a lighter warm orange wood with smooth, faint grain and a soft short shadow, in place of the dark noisy wood. Give the ball one small soft round highlight in place of the hard window shape, and soften the smoke into gentle teal wisps. Keep the gold stand and the pink swirl.

name: Magic Mirror
note: Magic Mirror: Make the green backdrop one even mid green to the corners, with a quiet tone-on-tone stripe pattern and no dark corners or floor glow. Show the glass as a soft pale reflection with one gentle sheen, in place of the diagonal white streaks. Make the gold frame slightly satin, with one soft highlight band; keep the scrolls and the base.

name: Haunted House
note: Haunted House: Remove the moon. Paint the walls a warm cream-tan stone with a few faint block lines, and the roof slate-blue in broad soft rows with no per-tile highlights. Let the window light glow only just around each window, with no yellow pool on the grass; keep the tower, the chimney and the night sky.

name: Iron Gate
note: Night Gate: Replace the cobblestones with a few large, smooth paving slabs in a light mauve. Make the pillars a warm sandstone with soft shading in place of the dark outlines and cracks, and lift the sky slightly to a medium dusk blue. Remove the moon, the chain and the padlock; keep the iron gate and the hedges.

name: Spooky Tree
note: Dead Tree: Paint the trunk as smooth warm brown bark with only a few broad, soft grooves that follow the twist, in place of the dense grain lines. Make the lawn a slightly softer, less acid green, and make the cast shadow short, soft and attached at the roots. Keep the purple stripes and the curled branches.

name: Tea Cup
note: Tea Cup: Make the tablecloth smooth soft cloth with a few broad folds and no visible weave, a step darker than the cup. Give the cup a slightly darker right side and a firm soft contact shadow under the saucer. Keep the rose decoration, the gold rims, the tea and the green stripes.

name: Top Hat
note: Top Hat: Make the crown smooth, soft matte grey felt with one broad, gentle highlight on the left, in place of the streaky brushed sheen. Let the right side of the crown and the underside of the brim fall into a slightly darker cool grey. Keep the purple band, the brim shape and the yellow sunburst.

name: Parasol
note: Parasol: Make the red canopy smooth, soft matte cloth with broad shading and no fabric weave. Draw the lace as a plain soft cream scalloped band, slightly darker than now, without small holes. Let the right panels and the underside of the canopy fall slightly darker; keep the ball tips, the ribs, the brown crook handle and the blue rings.

name: Straw Hat
note: Straw Hat: Paint the straw as a few broad, soft concentric bands with smooth satin shading, in place of the fine dense weave. Make the underside of the brim slightly darker so the hat stands out from the green. Keep the blue ribbon and bow, the hat shape and the green waves.

name: Pram
note: Pram: Replace the cobblestones with a smooth, cool grey stone floor of a few large, soft slabs with faint joints. Make the chrome frame and wheels soft satin silver with broad highlights, in place of the white glints. Keep the navy basket, the cream hood and the orange sunburst.

name: Front Door
note: Front Door: Move the camera closer so the red door and its stone surround fill the card, with the card edges cutting the fanlight arch and the step. Show only a thin strip of plain stone wall at each side, with no bushes and no paving. Keep the door colour, the panels, the brass knocker and the fanlight.

name: Flash Camera
note: Flash Camera: Make the flash dish and top plate smooth polished silver with broad soft highlights and no brushed streaks. Light the camera softly from the upper left, so the black body's right side is dark grey with a soft cool edge sheen, not near-black. Keep the red button, the lens and the blue rings.

name: Map Magnifier
note: Map Magnifier: Make the table under the map a light, warm honey wood in place of the dark red-brown. Draw the map streets and blocks as pale flat colour shapes with no dark lines, and make the paper slightly smoother. Keep the gold magnifier, the green park and the clear lens.

name: Badge Wallet
note: Badge Wallet: Lay the wallet on light, warm honey-orange wooden planks in bright daylight, in place of the dark brown wood. Make the leather smooth and softly shaded, with no stitch dashes and no pebbled grain. Keep the gold badge, the card and the pocket.

name: Evidence Bag
note: Evidence Bag: Set the bag on light, warm honey-orange wooden planks in bright daylight, in place of the dark wood. Light it softly from the upper left, with two or three broad clean highlight bands on the plastic and a soft contact shadow under its edges. Keep the gold ring and the blue zip strip.

name: Tape Roll
note: Tape Roll: Make the green backdrop one even mid green from centre to corners, with no dark vignette. Replace the long cast shadow with a short, soft contact shadow under the roll and the strip. Make the yellow tape slightly satin with one broad soft highlight; keep the cardboard core and the loose strip.

name: Doorknob Print
note: Door Knob: Make the green door a slightly lighter, brighter mid green. Draw the fingerprint as a smooth, soft pale swirl with no grain. Light the knob from the upper left with one broad soft sheen and a gently darker lower right; keep the brass plate, the screws and the room glimpse.

name: Squad Car
note: Police Car: Replace the long dark cast shadow with a soft, short, pale contact shadow under the wheels, and make the car's right side only slightly darker than the front. Make the road a smooth, slightly lighter grey-violet asphalt with no speckle. Keep the black-and-white car, the red light, the houses and the sky.

name: Pumpkin Step
note: Fountain: Make the table clean, warm wood planks with faint quiet grain, with no chipped paint, scratches or nail heads. Make the pumpkin skin smooth and glossy with no scratchy streaks; keep the glowing face, the stem and the blue stripes.

name: Broom
note: Binoculars: Make the grass a smooth, slightly deeper green lawn with soft broad shading and only a few blade hints, with no clovers. Add a soft, defined shadow on the grass beside the broom. Group the bristles into a few broad bundles; keep the red binding and the wooden handle.

name: Black Cat
note: Rocking Chair: Draw the stone ledge as smooth, warm grey blocks with soft edges and no speckle or pitting. Give the cat soft blue-violet highlights on its head, shoulders and haunch from the upper left. Calm the pink glow behind the cat slightly; keep the eyes, the ears and the purple stripes.

name: Candy Bowl
note: Candy Bowl: Make the table clean, warm, honey-coloured wood planks with faint quiet grain, with no chipped paint, scratches or nail heads. Give the glass a slightly brighter rim highlight; keep the candies and the blue ring backdrop.

name: Old Key
note: Key: Paint the key as smooth warm aged bronze with copper-orange and brown tones, in place of the gritty pitted grey iron. Give it one or two clean highlight bands along the top of the ring and shaft, and a slightly darker lower-right side. Add a soft, faint shadow below and to the right; keep the green sunburst and the diagonal pose.

name: Grandfather Clock
note: Grandfather Clock: Draw the clock slightly larger so it fills most of the card height. Make the green backdrop one even tone out to the corners, with no bright pool of light on the floor. Make the floor shadow short and soft; keep the wood case, the face and the gold pendulum.

name: Cobweb Window
note: Cobweb Window: Let the candle cast a slightly warm glow onto the inner frame and the sill. Make the glass a deep blue with one soft reflection, in place of flat black. Keep the stone wall, the cobweb and the night sky.

name: Street Lamp
note: Motel: Replace the small cobbles with a few large, soft warm grey-tan paving stones that fade out away from the lamp. Paint the post a deep green metal with a brass trim. Let the lantern's warm light spill slightly down the post and onto the nearby stones; keep the lantern and the dusk sky.

name: Top Hat
note: Top Hat: Make the hat a soft matte charcoal-plum felt with one broad soft sheen on the left of the crown, in place of the glossy black streaks. Let the underside of the brim fall to a medium-dark plum, not black. Keep the red band, the blue rings and the hat shape.

name: Violin
note: Bugle: Paint the violin body as smooth warm-orange wood with one broad soft highlight on the left and no visible flame grain. Make the chinrest, fingerboard and pegs a dark warm brown in place of black. Keep the green sunburst, the strings and the scroll.

name: Cake Stand
note: Cake Stand: Replace the white linen tablecloth with a smooth soft-pink tablecloth with a few large soft folds and no weave. Give the white porcelain a thin gold rim on each plate and slightly warmer cream shading with soft lilac shadows on the right. Lift the purple wall slightly to a medium violet; keep the cupcakes, the stripes and the stand.

name: Pearl Necklace
note: Pearl Necklace: Replace the dark velvet with a smooth mid-blue satin cloth with a few large soft folds and a soft light glow behind the bracelet. Paint the pearls warm creamy-pink, each with one soft white highlight from the upper left and a soft shadow on the lower right. Make the clasp a plain small gold loop; keep the round bracelet.

name: Piano
note: Piano: Make the wood a warm red-brown satin with a few faint long grain lines and no swirling mahogany figure. Make the floor a satin wood with faint grain and soft, blurred reflections. Let the top and left side catch slightly brighter light, with a slightly darker right side; keep the keys, the pedals and the striped wall.

name: Gold Badge
note: Gold Badge: Paint the gold face as a smooth, clean surface with no scratch or noise texture, bright at the upper left and turning slightly darker toward the lower right, with no glow bloom. Give the silver rim a soft satin sheen. Let the house emblem cast a small soft shadow down and to the right; keep the blue sunburst and the house emblem.

name: Briefcase
note: Briefcase: Make the leather a smooth, soft, slightly lighter tan with no pebble grain and no dashed stitch line along the flap. Light it from the upper left so the front face goes softly from bright at the top left to darker at the bottom right. Add a soft, slightly lighter violet glow on the backdrop behind the case; keep the gold clasps, the handle and the purple backdrop.

name: Print Card
note: Print Card: Replace the dark mahogany table with a light, warm honey-wood table with wide planks and faint, quiet grain, lit evenly and warmly. Draw the fingerprint as clean, smooth, deep-brown lines on a cream card. Make the ink pad a soft dark charcoal, slightly lighter than black; keep the red lid, the tin and the card.

name: Vintage Radio
note: Vintage Radio: Replace the dark mahogany table with a light, warm honey-wood tabletop with wide planks and faint, quiet grain. Paint the cabinet wood as smooth satin orange with only a few faint grain streaks, and give the brass knobs one soft, broad highlight each. Keep the purple stripes, the speaker grille and the dial.

name: Old Camera
note: Popcorn: Make the tabletop light, warm honey wood with a matte finish and faint, quiet grain. Paint the camera body a soft satin charcoal with a few broad highlights, slightly lighter than black. Make the flash dish one smooth, soft silver gradient with no radial ribs or white hot spot; keep the orange diamond wall, the bellows and the lens.

name: Neon Sign
note: Motel: Paint the brick wall as larger, smooth, soft orange blocks with thin, faint mortar lines and soft blue-violet shading toward the right. Make the wall bracket one smooth, plain rounded dark-steel bar with no bolts or plate screws. Add a soft cast shadow of the round sign on the wall below and to the right; keep the glowing magnifier icon, the night sky and the moon.

name: Yellow Taxi
note: Tour bus: Paint the road as smooth, soft blue-grey asphalt with no gritty speckle. Make the shadow under the taxi a soft, rich indigo-violet. Light the car from the left so its far side is slightly darker than the hood and roof; keep the yellow taxi, the checker band and the dusk sky.

name: Frosted Door
note: Door Wreath: Paint the brick wall as large, smooth, soft blocks with thin, faint mortar lines that fade away from the door. Light the scene from the upper left so the door frame casts a short soft shadow on the bricks and the shadows turn slightly blue-violet. Keep the brown door, the frosted window with the magnifier and the step.

name: Porch Pumpkin
note: Make the sky a bright daytime blue with soft clouds, in place of the night sky, moon and stars. Light the pumpkin from the upper left with a slightly darker right side, and keep only a soft warm glow inside the carved face. Keep the blue door, the ivy and the step.

name: Witch Hat
note: Paint the hat a deep purple felt with violet-blue shadows and one soft sheen on the left of the cone, in place of grey-black. Make the table lighter, warm honey wood with faint grain, and keep the green stripes evenly bright out to the corners. Keep the orange band, the gold buckle and the hat shape.

name: Hourglass
note: Paint the wood as smooth warm orange with one broad soft highlight on the left and only faint grain. Lift the darker top corners so the green backdrop is slightly more even, and make the shadow slightly shorter and softer. Keep the glass, the sand and the pose.

name: Spider
note: Paint the spider a deep purple-blue with one broad soft violet sheen from the upper left, in place of black. Make the stone slab smooth, warm sandy stone with soft edges and no cracks or moss. Keep the yellow spots, the eyes and the cyan ring backdrop.

name: Spell Book
note: Replace the dark planks with light, warm honey-coloured wood in broad soft stripes with shallow plank gaps. Make the purple cover slightly softer plum with lighter lilac edges. Keep the gold star, the clasp and the diagonal pose.

name: Treat Bucket
note: Make the table clean, warm, honey-coloured wood planks with faint quiet grain, with no nail heads, worn grey streaks or scuffs. Make the cast shadow slightly shorter and softer. Keep the pumpkin pail, the candies and the cyan rings.

name: Haunted Door
note: Make the sky strip a bright daytime blue, in place of the night sky, moon and stars. Paint the wall warm sandy stone with soft faint mortar lines and soft blue-violet shadows, in place of crisp grey bricks. Keep the arched door, the arch stones, the brass ring and the step.

name: Spooky Tree
note: Make the sky a bright soft daytime blue with a few small clouds, in place of the purple dusk. Replace the gazebo with more of the green hedge. Paint the trunk as smooth warm brown bark with a few broad soft twists, lit on the left; keep the tree's shape and the lawn.

name: Sheriff Pals
note: Sheriff Pals: Paint the saloon front faded blue-grey wood with white trim, in place of red. Make the deck boards soft, weathered grey-brown wood with faint plank lines. Keep the man, the pig, the hats, the mug and the blue sky.

name: Ranch Hands
note: Ranch Hands: Paint the hay bale as a few large, soft golden clumps with gentle shading, and remove the rope. Replace the red barn and fence with soft green bushes and more blue sky. Make the bucket plain matte grey metal with one soft highlight. Keep the rooster, the cow, the bandana and the tree.

name: Tea Time
note: Tea with the Pig: Replace the pink blossom canopy with a green leafy tree, and remove the pink petals from the grass. Make the tablecloth plain white. Keep the man, the pig, the tea set and the blue sky.

name: Grand Ball
note: Grand Ball: Make the floor a slightly cooler, softer grey-brown wood with faint, blurred reflections. Paint the ballroom walls a pale blue-grey. Light the dancers from the upper left so their right sides fall into soft shade. Keep the dance pose, the bonnet, the bow tie and the green curtains.

name: Cake Clue
note: Detective: Make the desk a soft, light blue-grey painted wood in place of the glossy orange-brown. Paint the trench coat as smooth matte tan with fewer seams and plain small buckles. Replace the filing cabinet and potted plant with more of the plain blue wall. Keep the chicken with the camera, the magnifier and the cake stand.

name: Hoofprint Clue
note: Sheep and Cow: Replace the straw floor with soft green grass, leaving a small patch of packed dirt around the hoofprint and only a few straw wisps. Replace the red barn and hay bales on the right with soft green trees. Keep the sheep, the cow, the magnifiers and the blue sky.

name: Covered Wagon
note: Covered Wagon: Make the dirt floor a smooth, clean, light sandy brown with soft broad shading, with no pebbles or specks. Give the wagon one soft contact shadow under its wheels. Keep the wagon, the red wheels, the canvas cover and the green striped wall.

name: Windmill
note: Windmill: Paint the field as a smooth, soft golden meadow with broad gentle shading, with no individual grass strands or rocks. Shade the wheel blades a slightly cooler off-white with soft blue-grey undersides. Keep the red tower, the yellow tail vane, the blue sky and the clouds.

name: Campfire
note: Campfire: Replace the log cabin with more soft green pine trees and blue sky. Remove the kettle and its stone, and the small pebbles and grass clumps on the ground. Keep the fire, the logs, the stone ring and the warm glow.

name: Hat Box
note: Hat Box: Light the box from the upper left so the right third of the red drum turns clearly darker, and make the navy lid top slightly brighter than its side band. Give the red sides a soft matte paper-board finish with a slightly darker contact shadow at the base. Keep the shape, the rope handle and the green backdrop.

name: Cake Stand
note: Cake Stand: Make the back wall a light lilac with soft, gentle stripes in place of the dark purple. Make the tablecloth plain smooth white fabric with no visible weave. Slightly darken the undersides of the plates and give the stand a satin finish with highlights only on the rims. Keep the stand, the cakes and the table corner.

name: Steamer Trunk
note: Steamer Trunk: Replace the grey cracked flagstones and the yellow strip with a few large, smooth, warm sandy stone slabs with soft faint joints. Paint the wood as smooth red-brown with faint quiet grain. Make the straps plain leather bands with no stitching or punched holes. Keep the trunk, the brass corners, the buckles and the blue rays.

name: Pearl Necklace
note: Pearl Necklace: Replace the dark tufted velvet with a smooth, softly shaded satin cushion in a warm dusty rose, with no buttons and no fibre fuzz, a little lighter overall. Light the pearls from the upper left, with one small soft highlight each and slightly darker lower-right pearls. Keep the bracelet, the gold clasp and the top-down view.

name: Piano
note: Rock Guitar: Paint the piano as smooth satin red-brown wood with faint quiet grain and highlights only on the top edges, in place of glossy lacquered grain. Make the wall a soft plain blue-grey with a faint pattern, in place of the cream damask. Make the floor matte honey wood with soft, faint reflections. Keep the piano, the keys, the pedals and the view.

name: Flashlight
note: Lantern: Flashlight: Paint the red barrel as satin red with one broad soft highlight along the top, in place of the hard white streaks. Make the head ring a plain smooth silver band. Keep the flashlight, the ribbed grip, the yellow beam and the cyan rays.

name: Magnifier
note: Hoop Shot: Magnifier: Make the lens glass clear pale blue-white instead of green. Replace the white dot on the glass with a soft curved reflection along the upper-left edge. Keep the silver ring, the red handle and the green ring backdrop.

name: Badge Wallet
note: Travel Book: Wallet: Replace the dark wood planks with bright, warm orange wood with a few broad, soft grain bands. name: Cake Stand
note: Cake Stand: Make the tablecloth smooth, soft lilac fabric with a few broad folds and no fine wrinkles, slightly darker than the white stand. Keep the stand, the cakes, the purple striped wall and the view.

name: Piano
note: Piano: Replace the cream damask wallpaper with a soft, plain pale blue wall with broad, gentle vertical stripes. Make the floor reflections slightly softer and fainter. Keep the piano, its wood color, the keys, the pedals and the view.

name: Flash Camera
